code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (very low arterial pH and oxygen saturation), with normocytic, mildly hypochromic anemia, thrombocytopenia, and mild leukopenia with neutropenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. Total protein is slightly low, but liver and kidney function are within normal limits. Findings suggest acute or chronic respiratory failure with possible underlying hematologic disorder; urgent clinical assessment is recommended.
